original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚军机坠入沼泽致32人遇难，全国哀悼三日
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚一架军用飞机在南部翁多州坠入沼泽，造成32人死亡，总统蒂努布宣布全国哀悼三天并下令彻查。当局称该机当时正执行从贝宁城飞往拉各斯的例行任务。这是自1992年以来尼日利亚军方最严重的一起空难。

location.site: 一处海军基地附近的沼泽
location.raw_text: a swamp near a naval base in Igbokoda, Ondo state

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚一架军用飞机在南部翁多州坠毁，造成32人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a military aircraft crashed in southern Ondo State, killing 32 people

key_facts.fact: 当局称该机当时正执行从贝宁城飞往拉各斯的例行任务
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the plane was on a routine mission from Benin City to Lagos when it came down in a swamp near a naval base on Monday morning

key_facts.fact: 总统蒂努布宣布全国哀悼三天并下令全面调查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Nigeria's President Bola Tinubu has declared three days of national mourning ... has ordered a full investigation

key_facts.fact: 这是自1992年以来尼日利亚军方最严重的一起空难
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: It is the deadliest crash involving a Nigerian military aircraft since 1992

key_facts.fact: 航空部长称该机尾号为NGR 931，从贝宁飞往拉各斯途中失联
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the disappearance of a military aircraft with tail number NGR 931, enroute Lagos from Benin at 0913 hours earlier today

uncertainties: 坠机原因尚未查明，有待调查
